description: Global Status working release with settings persistence
changes: Fixed critical bug where server settings were not persisted to Stream Deck storage
Added extensive logging to settings manager and Global Status for debugging
Added console logging to Global Status page for troubleshooting
Improved error handling when sending WebSocket messages
Fixed JavaScript syntax error in Global Status HTML page
features: Global Status now shows 'No servers configured' message immediately
Better client-side diagnostics with browser console logging
fixes: Global Status page stuck on 'Loading servers...' indefinitely
Server configurations not being saved properly between plugin restarts
JavaScript syntax error causing Global Status page to fail loading
Silent failures in WebSocket message broadcasting
notes: This is the stable release that fixes Global Status. v2.4.9 had settings persistence fix but JavaScript error, v2.4.10 fixed the JS error. This v2.5.0 consolidates all fixes into a proper working release.
